|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Walker Sighting (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “This card is Destiny +3 when drawn for destiny if there is an AT-AT or AT-ST on table. ▲ Concussion Grenade, Panic, or Logistical Delay. [Immune to Sense] OR If an opponent's AT-AT or AT-ST is on table, you may glance at the top card of opponent's Reserve Deck. You may use 2 Force to cause that card to be lost.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “''While an AT-AT or AT-ST on table, destiny +3.'' take Concussion Grenade, Logistical Delay, or Panic into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Sense.) OR If opponent’s AT-AT or AT-ST on table, peek at the top card of their Reserve Deck; may use 2 Force to make it lost.” '''What changed:''' “This card is Destiny +3 when drawn for destiny if there is” → “''While”; “table. ▲” → “table, destiny +3.'' take”; “Panic,” → “Logistical Delay,”; “Logistical Delay. [Immune” → “Panic into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune”; “Sense]” → “Sense.)”; “an opponent's” → “opponent’s”; removed “is”; “you may glance” → “peek”; “opponent's” → “their”; “Deck. You” → “Deck;”; “cause that card to be” → “make it”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 23. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
